Resource build inputs

The original i18nFlags_16x11.rc referenced bitmap sources absent from this vendored
subset. Flags 16x11/*.bmp were restored losslessly from the original BITMAP
resources; upstream licensing and attribution are unchanged. The flag RC paths
use forward slashes for standard Windows RC escape handling.

The i18n/i18nDB/i18nDesign RC files preserve the original package version data.
Rebuild with python tools/build_resources.py --vendor from the recorder root,
or compile each RC in this directory with the Windows SDK Resource Compiler.
Compiled *.res files are ignored build outputs, not repository/source-archive inputs.
